_meta.description:
Phase 5.9 (s191, 2026-05-14) + Phase 5.9.5 (s192, 2026-05-14) + Phase 5.9.6 (s193, 2026-05-14) + Phase 5.9.7 (s194, 2026-05-14) — per-(champion, key) block_index_overrides for the ds.ability + ds.burst scorers. Default block_index=0 picks the first damage block of the canonical form, which matches the engine's pre-s191 `block_strategy="first"` behavior and is correct for ~95% of champions. A minority of champions have a later damage block that represents the realistic burst-window damage: the empowered/total/max variant that fires when canonical conditions are met (target poisoned, target chilled, full-charge windup, all bounces same target, sub-execute HP, full-channel duration, max sphere stacks, etc.). For ranking purposes (operator is comparing item builds for *their* champion in *their* combo), assuming amped conditions are met is the right model — same intuition as the engine already baking in `target_missing_hp_pct` and treating skillshots as landed. Keys are DDragon canonical ids; values map ability key (Q/W/E/R) OR repeat-variant token (Q2/W2/E2/R2 — Phase 5.9.5) to the 0-indexed block_index to use when the operator doesn't supply an explicit dict. Operator's per-call dict still wins per-key — registry fills any keys the caller didn't override.

Token-level lookup precedence (Phase 5.9.5): the burst combo walker checks the CANONICAL token first (e.g., "R2" for the Akali R recast), then falls back to the base ABILITY KEY (e.g., "R"). This lets a champion model its multi-step ability sequence with different block selections per token instance. `compute_ability_dps` is unaffected — it only iterates base spell keys (Q/W/E/R), so any R2-keyed entry is invisible to the mage scorer; token-variant entries only fire in the burst combo walker.

Phase 5.9.6 (s193): adds 8 new champion entries + extends Anivia (Q=2). Most are 'per-tick → total' wins for channeled abilities (Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, Velkoz R Disintegration Ray, AurelionSol E Singularity, MissFortune E Make It Rain, Samira R Inferno Trigger, Alistar E Trample, Singed Q Poison Trail) where the engine's default 'first damage block' picks the per-tick value but the real per-cast contribution is the full-channel total. Syndra R uses block 2 for max-sphere-stack realistic-burst case (typically 7+ Dark Spheres at level 11+).

Phase 5.9.7 (s194): closes the s193 calibration-follow-up list. Adds Corki W=1 (Valkyrie fire trail full-duration total) + Corki E=1 (Gatling Gun full-channel) + Hecarim W=1 (Spirit of Dread full-aura) + Hecarim E=1 (Devastating Charge max-charge) + Jayce Q=1 (Shock Blast Acceleration Gate increased damage, layered on s187's Jayce Q form_index=1 cannon-form override — orthogonal: form_index selects cannon form 1, block_index then selects the gate-amped block 1 within that form) + Jayce W=1 (Lightning Field hammer-aura full duration) + Rell R=1 (Magnet Storm full-channel total) + DrMundo W=1 (Heart Zapper full-channel drain total; block 2 recast detonation is a separate +25% one-time burst not summed in current schema — minor under-count, acceptable). All entries verified against Meraki ATTR names (per-tick → total or min → max amped variants); the channel/aura/charge family closes the systematic under-count for non-mage/non-assassin ability-based champions queried via /ability-dps + /burst direct routes.
_meta.rationale:
Per-(champion, key) entries (verified against data/daemon_slayer/16.10.1/champion_abilities.json):
  Ahri Q block1 'Total Mixed Damage' = 2× block0 'Damage Per Pass' (orb both passes)
  Akali R block0 'Magic Damage' = R1 base damage with 30% AP + 50% bonus AD (initial dash cast)
  Akali R2 block2 'Maximum Magic Damage' = R2 max-execute scaling (210/420/630 + 90% AP vs low-HP target via missing-HP curve); R1 keeps block0 because it has its own bonus-AD scaling and the missing-HP amp only fires on the recast
  Alistar E block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full-Trample-channel total (per-tick × 10 ticks at rank 5: 20 × 10 = 200 base, 7% AP × 10 = 70% AP)
  Anivia Q block2 'Total Magic Damage' = block 0 (initial pass) + block 1 (detonation) — full Flash Frost commit
  Anivia E block1 'Enhanced Damage' = 2× block0 vs chilled target (Q stun applies chill)
  AurelionSol E block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full-Singularity duration sum (per-tick × ~20 ticks at rank 5: 7.5 × 20 = 150 base)
  Aurora Q block2 'Maximum Magic Damage' = full-charged Twofold Hex (1.5× of block0/1)
  Belveth E block2 'Maximum Physical Damage per hit' = full-channel Royal Maelstrom (4× block1 min)
  Brand W block1 'Increased Damage' = 1.25× block0 vs CC'd or Blaze-stacked target
  Brand R block1 'Total Single-Target Damage' = 3× block0 (all bounces back to same target)
  Cassiopeia E block1 'Total Enhanced Damage' = canonical Twin Fang amp vs poisoned (Q/W applies poison)
  Corki W block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full Valkyrie fire-trail duration (per-tick 40-100 + 30% AP + 40% bAD × ~5 ticks = 200-500 + 150% AP + 200% bAD); block 0 is per-tick of the trail
  Corki E block1 'Total Physical Damage' = full Gatling Gun 4-second channel (per-tick 5-17.5 + 15% bAD × 16 shots = 80-280 + 240% bAD)
  Diana W block2 'Total Magic Damage' = 3× block1 per-orb (all 3 Pale Cascade orbs land)
  DrMundo W block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full Heart Zapper 4-second drain channel (per-tick 5-20 × 16 ticks = 80-320 base, also 1% bonus HP per tick × 16 = 16% bonus HP total); block 2 'Magic Damage' is the recast detonation +25% one-time burst, not summed in current single-block_index schema (minor under-count, acceptable)
  Evelynn R block1 'Empowered Damage' = 2.4× block0 vs sub-30% HP target (Last Caress execute)
  Fiddlesticks R block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full-Crowstorm-channel total (per-tick × ~20 ticks at rank 3: 87.5 × 20 = 1750 base, 12.5% × 20 = 250% AP)
  Hecarim W block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full Spirit of Dread 4-second aura (per-tick 20-60 + 20% AP × 5 ticks = 100-300 + 100% AP)
  Hecarim E block1 'Maximum Physical Damage' = full-charge Devastating Charge after running 250 units (2× block 0 'Minimum Physical Damage'); operator commits to full charge in burst window — same modeling as Belveth E
  Jayce Q block1 'Increased Damage' = Shock Blast through Acceleration Gate (canonical Jayce combo — fires E gate first, then Q through it for 1.4× damage); layered on s187's Jayce Q form_index=1 cannon-form override (form_index resolves to cannon form 1; block_index=1 then selects the gate-amped block within that form)
  Jayce W block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full Lightning Field hammer-form 4-second aura (per-tick 35-95 + 25% AP × 4 ticks = 140-380 + 100% AP); form 0 = hammer is default — form 1 (cannon Hyper Charge) has no damage block
  Karma W block1 'Total Magic Damage' = 2× block0 per-tick (full Focused Resolve channel)
  MissFortune E block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full-Make-It-Rain-duration sum (per-tick × 8 ticks at rank 5: 23.75 × 8 = 190 base)
  Rell R block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full Magnet Storm 4-second channel (per-tick 15-35 + 13.75% AP × 8 ticks = 120-280 + 110% AP)
  Samira R block1 'Total Physical Damage' = full-Inferno-Trigger spray total (per-shot × 10 shots at rank 3: 25 × 10 = 250 base)
  Singed Q block1 'Total Magic Damage' = enemy stays in poison trail full duration (per-tick × 8 ticks at rank 5: 15 × 8 = 120 base, 10.625% × 8 = 85% AP)
  Syndra R block2 'Maximum Magic Damage' = burst at 7+ Dark Spheres stacked (typically achieved by level 11+ with Q/E charges); block 0 is per-sphere baseline, block 1 is min 3-sphere case, block 2 is max-stack burst-window
  Udyr R block1 (note: Udyr not in registry — kept channel default for now; may add if calibration shows under-counting)
  Veigar R block1 'Maximum Magic Damage' = 2× block0 vs executed target (Primordial Burst at low HP)
  Velkoz R block1 'Maximum Damage' = full-Life-Form-Disintegration-Ray channel (per-tick × ~13 ticks at rank 3: 61.54 × 13 ≈ 800 base, 9.62% × 13 = 125% AP)
  Vex R block2 'Total Magic Damage' = block0 + block1 (Shadow Surge initial + mark detonation both land)

Deliberately skipped:
  AurelionSol R — Empowered variant lives in form_index=1, not block_index; covered by future form_index override if needed
  AurelionSol Q — block2 'Total Maximum Magic Damage' is the no-early-release case which is rare in practice; block 0 default is realistic for short-charge case
  Caitlyn Q — block1 'Reduced Damage' is the FALLBACK case (units in line behind first hit), block0 IS the realistic burst case; no override needed
  Corki R — block 1 'Big One Physical Damage' is only every 4th missile (charge-based, not per-cast amped); requires conditional resource-state modeling to apply correctly
  Kennen R — block1 'Total Single-Target Damage' requires all 12 bolts hitting the same target which is rare; default per-tick more realistic
  DrMundo E — block0 is no-base stat-bonus, block1/2 require knowing current vs missing HP threshold; deferred (could benefit but ambiguous default)
  Renekton Q — block1 'Enhanced Damage' requires full Fury (50+); high but not universally assumable in burst window
  Renekton R — block1 'Total Magic Damage' is the 15-second passive splash total; too long-duration for burst-window assumption
  Aatrox W — block3 'Total Damage' requires chain landing then pull-back; CC-conditional
  Anivia R — channel ticks are ambiguous per-cast (block2 is amped but per-tick, not per-channel-total)
  Rumble R — block2 'Maximum Magic Damage' assumes full-duration channel which is realistic but Rumble R is also frequently zoned (1.5s of 4s commit); defer until calibration data
  Yone Q1/Q2/Q3 — Yone's three-stage Q chain has only one damage block per form (knockup is utility, not damage); block 0 for all three is correct
  Zed Q vs Q2-shadow — Zed Q has block0 (full) + block1 (reduced for non-first hits); the in-game model is single-target full damage for whichever Q lands first, so block 0 for both Q and Q2 is correct
  Leblanc Q vs Q2-mimic — Mimic-Q has its own damage formula not in Meraki's block schema; out of scope until Meraki ingests the mimic forms
  Gwen Q multi-snip / Aatrox Q chain / Akshan R bullets — complex multi-block forms with per-stage variants; defer per-champion modeling until each can be verified in isolation

Further expansion candidates remain (~220 multi-block forms across the roster). Operator can extend the registry per-champion as needed; default block_index=0 preserves pre-s191 behavior for any unmapped entry.
